findings.summary: Lockfile regenerated for contracts only; missing all 16 apps/api deps; breaks wave-1 frozen-install gate.
findings.suggested_fix: Run `pnpm install` at repo root (not filtered) so apps/api specifiers land in pnpm-lock.yaml. Verify `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` exits 0 before staging.

findings.summary: `test.projects` is a Vitest v3 API; lockfile resolves vitest@2.1.9 where this key is ignored — integration suite won't run as configured.
findings.suggested_fix: Either bump apps/api devDeps to `vitest@^3` (also packages/contracts for consistency), or move to v2's `test.workspace` model: top-level `workspace: './vitest.workspace.ts'` referencing two project configs.

findings.summary: `exports` points at './src/index.ts' while build emits only .d.ts (emitDeclarationOnly). Workspace-internal consumers OK; external Node consumers cannot resolve.
findings.suggested_fix: If contracts is workspace-only (per ARCHITECTURE §6.2 it is), leave as-is and document; otherwise use conditional exports `{ "types": "./dist/index.d.ts", "import": "./src/index.ts" }` and emit JS.

findings.summary: `typecheck` script uses `tsc --noEmit` while project is `composite: true` and downstream tasks use `tsc -b` — mixed invocation modes risk stale tsbuildinfo.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace scripts.typecheck with `tsc -b` (consistent with contracts/tsconfig.json composite and downstream task-contracts-auth verification).

findings.summary: tsc -b produced packages/contracts/{tsconfig.tsbuildinfo,dist/*}; tsbuildinfo not in target_files and not covered by root .gitignore.
findings.suggested_fix: Add `*.tsbuildinfo` to root .gitignore (next wave's update list); dist/ is already ignored. No code change required this wave.

findings.summary: pnpm-lock.yaml is outside target_files for both wave-2 tasks; explicitly waived by wave instructions as expected install side-effect.
findings.suggested_fix: No action; informational scope-drift entry for audit completeness. The substantive issue is captured by F-001.
